title: Two moves and a direction to protect

ask.text: Write the stretch it admits.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.
Lift the lip, then share by the count — and the count is inverted.
With the lip gone the rail carries -1 against an inverted count of 5.

worldFraming.text: If anything turned over on the way, the stretch is on the other side of the mark when you look up.
